raw_text: China has constructed a new bridge near Finger 8 on the north bank of Pangong Tso in eastern Ladakh, according to satellite imagery reviewed by The Indian Express. The bridge, estimated to be around 30 metres in length, connects two previously separated positions along the lake's northern shore. Defence sources said the Indian Army is closely monitoring the situation and has reinforced its own positions in the Finger 4 to Finger 8 corridor. The construction comes despite ongoing military-diplomatic talks between India and China.
